🇮🇱 Israel's election ends in deadlock, neither Netanyahu nor his rival can form a government

With about 90% of votes counted, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's bloc (Likud, Shas, United Torah Judaism, Ben-Gvir's Otzma Yehudit and Smotrich's Religious Zionism) stands at 53 seats, eight short of the 61 needed for a majority in the 120-seat parliament.

The opposition bloc led by former army chief Gadi Eisenkot, architect of the "Dahiya doctrine" of flattening civilian areas in Lebanon, has only 48 seats. Likud remains the largest party with 26 seats, followed by Eisenkot's Yashar party with 21. The joint list of former prime ministers Naftali Bennett and Yair Lapid managed just 12.

The surprise of the night was the Arab parties, which nearly doubled their result to 19 seats on high turnout among Palestinian citizens of Israel. On paper, they now hold the balance of power. In practice, both Netanyahu and Eisenkot refused to work with them before the vote.

Yair Golan, leader of the left-wing Democrats in Eisenkot's camp, is now the only one in the bloc openly calling for a partnership with the Arab parties.

Israeli President Isaac Herzog is urging parties to avoid yet another election and reportedly favors a unity government, but Eisenkot has ruled out serving under Netanyahu. Official results are expected next week, after which Herzog will begin consultations. Until then, Netanyahu stays on as caretaker prime minister.

🎙 IRGC downs MQ-1 drone near Strait of Hormuz

📌 Tehran, IRNA – Iran’s Islamic Revolution Guards Corps (IRGC) has announced the interception and destruction of an American MQ-1 drone over the eastern Strait of Hormuz.

According to a statement published on the IRGC’s website on Thursday, the drone was brought down by the force’s Aerospace Division using an advanced air defense system operating under Iran’s integrated air defense network.
​
The statement said that it was the 14th advanced MQ-1 drone that was intercepted and destroyed.
​
As part of its defensive measures in response to the US-Israeli war of aggression against Iran, launched on February 28, the Islamic Republic has assumed control of the Strait of Hormuz and set regulations on maritime traffic through the waterway. Iran has repeatedly warned vessels against using routes it has not authorized.
